_note: Godstorm two-pyramid FINAL UPDATE manifest, 2026-09-19. Existing numeric completion rewards and quest cadence/attempt fields are preserved from captured live records. Scene-character arrays remain empty/deferred because no accepted keeper/blank SCENE_CHARACTER records exist yet. No live operation is performed by this repository file.

data.name: Marrow Vaults
data.description: Beneath Stormcourt lie the Marrow Vaults, where the Unbroken Thread confined the elder sister and studied her light-devouring blood. Enter through the lower vaults and defeat all twenty-five enemies, including the five keepers, to open the passage to the court above.
data.successDescription: Marrow Vaults is cleared. The passage to Stormcourt above is open.

objectives.description: You enter through the lower vaults beneath Stormcourt. Tally-marks cover the entrance: feedings, measurements, years. The Unbroken Thread recorded the elder sister's captivity in a careful administrative hand. An Umbral Reaver guards the first passage. Thunder from the court above reaches you through the stone.
Battle 1/25: Umbral Reaver.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: Beyond the first guard, a Hollow Lantern waits beside another row of tally-marks. A narrow strip of stone has been rubbed smooth where someone repeatedly counted the days by touch.
Battle 2/25: Hollow Lantern.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The next chamber has no window. A Starless Monk stands before the inner doorway, holding the same watch recorded on the walls outside.
Battle 3/25: Starless Monk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel blocks the approach to the keeper's hall. Behind it, the prison records give way to bare stone. No visitor was meant to pass this point.
Battle 4/25: Nightveil Sentinel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An armored figure rises from a plain chair at the end of the hall. It was the first guard the Thread set over the elder sister's prison. The Warden of the First Dark takes its place across the passage.
Battle 5/25: Warden of the First Dark.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: Past the fallen Warden, sound begins to fail. Your footsteps disappear a pace behind you. The records call the elder sister stable, compliant, watched. A Hollow Lantern guards the chambers where her silence was kept.
Battle 6/25: Hollow Lantern.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk waits where the passage bends. Its sleeves move as it turns, but you hear no cloth against stone. The silence reaches into every corner of this chamber.
Battle 7/25: Starless Monk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The same assessment appears on successive records, copied without alteration. A Nightveil Sentinel stands beneath them. Nothing here acknowledges how many years passed between the entries.
Battle 8/25: Nightveil Sentinel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver guards the last approach. Beyond it, a stopped clock marks an hour the records never explain. The silence is deepest near the keeper.
Battle 9/25: Umbral Reaver.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A veiled figure stands beneath the stopped clock, keeping a silence nineteen winters old. The Keeper of Hushed Hours turns toward you. There is no sound as its robes move.
Battle 10/25: Keeper of Hushed Hours.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: Beyond the Keeper's chamber, pale mothlight gathers overhead. The insects cling where the elder sister's chakra consumed the light, searching the stone for what is gone. A Starless Monk waits beneath them.
Battle 11/25: Starless Monk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel interrupts your path through the pale glow. Moths scatter from its shoulders and settle again on the wall behind it.
Battle 12/25: Nightveil Sentinel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The light weakens as you approach an Umbral Reaver. The moths avoid the space around it, leaving a dark break in the drifting swarm.
Battle 13/25: Umbral Reaver.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern keeps the final approach. Above it, the separate points of mothlight begin to gather. Something heavier moves among the wings.
Battle 14/25: Hollow Lantern.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The mothlight closes around a crowned shape. Its wings resemble burnt pages, and its body is swollen with the light it has consumed. The Moth Tyrant descends to meet you.
Battle 15/25: The Moth Tyrant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: The moths fall back from the next chamber. Ritual chains hang in ordered rows over slabs stained by needles. A low voice recites the binding verses. A Nightveil Sentinel guards the first row.
Battle 16/25: Nightveil Sentinel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver stands among the hanging chains. Their lowest links drag across the slabs, worn smooth by years of use.
Battle 17/25: Umbral Reaver.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern waits beside the bindings. Each pause in the distant verse is answered by a small movement through the chains. The rite is still being kept.
Battle 18/25: Hollow Lantern.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk blocks the last gap between the chains. The singing continues beyond it, measured and unchanged by the fighting in the outer rooms.
Battle 19/25: Starless Monk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The singing stops. The chains lift and settle around a hooded figure, each one drawn into position. The Chained Chorister steps forward to defend the binding chamber.
Battle 20/25: Chained Chorister.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: At the end of the vaults, a divided threshold seals the stair to Stormcourt. Cold silver covers one half; the other returns no light. The elder sister's chakra has soaked through the stone. An Umbral Reaver guards the crossing.
Battle 21/25: Umbral Reaver.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern waits near the silver edge. Its outline sharpens there, then disappears where the darkness touches its robes.
Battle 22/25: Hollow Lantern.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk holds the narrow approach. Behind it, the two halves of the threshold meet without blending. Nothing moves beyond that seam.
Battle 23/25: Starless Monk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel is the last guard before the stair. The marks of confinement end here. Beyond the threshold, the passage rises toward the court above.
Battle 24/25: Nightveil Sentinel.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The Warden of the Half Eclipse stands where silver meets dark, wearing both halves like a mantle. It has been partly consumed by what it guarded. The Warden draws its blade across the foot of the stair.
Battle 25/25: Warden of the Half Eclipse.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Marrow Vaults remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Marrow Vaults.
objectives.successDescription: The last keeper falls.

objectives.description: The Warden of the Half Eclipse falls, leaving the stair beyond the divided threshold unguarded. Thunder rolls down from Stormcourt above. The elder sister's prison is cleared, but the younger sister's storm is still bound in the court overhead. The way up is open.
This attempt ends before Marrow Vaults is cleared.
The stair to Stormcourt is open.
objectives.successDescription: Marrow Vaults is cleared. The passage to Stormcourt above is open.

data.name: Stormcourt
data.description: Above the Marrow Vaults lies Stormcourt, where the Unbroken Thread bound the younger sister's storm. Enter from the cleared vaults below and defeat all twenty-five enemies, including the five keepers. Bring down the Sovereign Echo of the Godstorm to end the binding.
data.successDescription: Stormcourt is cleared. The Sovereign Echo is defeated, and the binding is broken.

objectives.description: The stair from Marrow Vaults opens into Stormcourt. Enclosed stone gives way to wind and rain, and the thunder you heard below breaks overhead. Scorched marks spread across the court at the height of a young girl. A Hollow Lantern Ascendant guards the approach to the tribunal.
Battle 1/25: Hollow Lantern Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk Ascendant waits along the tribunal approach. A voice almost forms inside the thunder, then breaks apart before you can distinguish a word.
Battle 2/25: Starless Monk Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant holds the next crossing. Its outline remains steady in a gust that drives rain sideways across the court.
Battle 3/25: Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver Ascendant blocks the way to the Judge. The fighting has not disturbed the figure waiting beyond it. The gavel remains raised.
Battle 4/25: Umbral Reaver Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A robed figure waits with a dark gavel. This tribunal heard a girl say that the thunder spoke, then ruled her mad. The Gloaming Judge turns from its empty hearing to confront you.
Battle 5/25: The Gloaming Judge.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: Beyond the tribunal, frost traces the sheltered edges of the court. A waning crescent shows through the cloud. A Starless Monk Ascendant stands between you and the veiled figure waiting beneath it.
Battle 6/25: Starless Monk Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant guards the cold stone. Meltwater runs a short distance from its feet before freezing again in the joints.
Battle 7/25: Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver Ascendant advances across the frost. Behind it, the veiled figure remains still. Only the pale edges of her blades move in the wind.
Battle 8/25: Umbral Reaver Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern Ascendant keeps the Widow's approach. The air grows colder as you near it, and the next peal of thunder arrives thin and distant.
Battle 9/25: Hollow Lantern Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The frost parts around the Widow of the Waning Moon. She has kept her mourning for what the Thread took long before your arrival. She lifts two blades of fading moonlight and faces you.
Battle 10/25: Widow of the Waning Moon.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: Beyond the Widow, old wax fills the joints between the stones. Rows of spent candles lean against one another, their wicks drowned by rain. A Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant guards the surviving work.
Battle 11/25: Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver Ascendant advances among the dead candles. Small sheltered flames persist farther ahead, relit as quickly as the weather extinguishes them.
Battle 12/25: Umbral Reaver Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern Ascendant guards a line of candle stubs. Wax has hardened around their bases in layers, each failed lighting buried beneath the next.
Battle 13/25: Hollow Lantern Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk Ascendant keeps the last approach to the light-keeper. Beyond it, wax is being worked around a fresh wick. The hands do not stop when you arrive.
Battle 14/25: Starless Monk Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The Candlewright turns from its work, crusted in old wax and crowned with small flames. The Thread charged it with holding back the girl's weather. It is still tending the candles after every flame around it has failed.
Battle 15/25: The Candlewright.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: Past the Candlewright, the wind circles the court instead of crossing it. Every gust returns toward the central dais. An Umbral Reaver Ascendant guards the first break in that circling current.
Battle 16/25: Umbral Reaver Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Hollow Lantern Ascendant holds the next passage. Behind it, something strikes a low note that you feel through the wet stone before you hear it.
Battle 17/25: Hollow Lantern Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk Ascendant waits where the gusts meet. The pressure pulls at your clothes from opposing directions. The sound ahead resolves into a horn.
Battle 18/25: Starless Monk Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant stands before the Herald. Beyond it, a storm-wreathed figure lifts a war horn toward the central dais.
Battle 19/25: Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.

objectives.description: The Herald of the Last Dusk sets the horn to its lips. Its call draws an answer from the storm binding at the center of the court. The Herald steps into your path as the note fades.
Battle 20/25: Herald of the Last Dusk.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The keeper falls. The next passage is clear.

objectives.description: The Herald's horn is silent. Ahead, an eye of still air surrounds the central dais while rain races around its edge. A Hollow Lantern Ascendant guards the instruments that hold the storm in place.
Battle 21/25: Hollow Lantern Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Starless Monk Ascendant waits beside the binding instruments. Violet light passes between them, and the pressure rises each time the current reaches the dais.
Battle 22/25: Starless Monk Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.

objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: A Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant guards the still air. Beyond it, empty armor stands upright. Lightning moves beneath the plates where a body should be.
Battle 23/25: Nightveil Sentinel Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: An Umbral Reaver Ascendant closes the last approach. The voice inside the thunder comes from the armor behind it. Nothing remains between you and the source except this final guard.
Battle 24/25: Umbral Reaver Ascendant.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The guardian falls. You can advance.

objectives.description: The Sovereign Echo of the Godstorm moves from the dais: empty armor held upright by pressure and violet lightning. It wears the younger sister's siphoned storm like a body. The cry in its helm swells as it takes the field.
Battle 25/25: Sovereign Echo of the Godstorm.
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ends in a draw. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.failDescription: You are defeated. Stormcourt remains uncleared.
objectives.fleeDescription: You disengage before clearing Stormcourt.
objectives.successDescription: The last keeper falls.

objectives.description: The Sovereign Echo collapses. Lightning leaves the empty armor, and the binding instruments fall silent. Rain crosses the upper court without being drawn back toward the dais. For the first time since you entered the vaults below, the thunder carries no voice. The Thread's prison beneath the court and its storm binding above are both broken.
This attempt ends before Stormcourt is cleared.
You leave Stormcourt as the rain settles over the silent court.
objectives.successDescription: Stormcourt is cleared. The binding is broken.
